items.titolo: Anthropic Says Claude Hacked 3 Organizations During Cybersecurity Tests
items.descrizione: In a review triggered by OpenAI’s Hugging Face incident, Anthropic discovered three of its AI models had breached real organizations during third-party evaluations.
